text:
fiona: morning — deploybot auto-pinned runtime:4.0 -> runtime:3.9 in ap-southeast-1 at ~00:40 UTC. Memory pressure on q4b-quant hosts spiked. Anyone awake?

deploybot: ALERT pinned runtime:4.0 -> runtime:3.9 on pool:hosted-ap-southeast-1 at 2026-03-21T00:41:03Z (trigger: host mem > 82% for 90s). Eviction log: /deploys/606543/mem-evict

kai: saw the alert. Looks like quantized-model q4b-v2 has a new allocator path in runtime:4.0 that increases resident set for longseq workloads. We flagged it in the runtime PR but assumed warmup behavior would be fine.

henry: Are we pinning models too? Some model bundles reference runtime:4.0-only kernels; pin might cause mismatch for newer model variants.

fiona: deploybot only pinned runtime on the host pool, not model bundles. But clients hitting newer model variants may now be routed away depending on compatibility rules. We should confirm routing fallback.

infra-bot: ROUTING CHECK: model-variant q4b-v2 requires runtime >=4.0 for optimized kernels. Fallback policy: route to compatible variant (q4b-v1) if runtime <4.0 available.

kai: That fallback will increase latency but keep requests alive. We saw a small p95 bump ~40ms. Not customer-facing yet, but we should fix allocator before a global rollout.

marta: Is this caused by the recent SDK change that enabled eager-cache? SDK 3.2 toggled a client-side prefetch that increases concurrency; combined with runtime allocator change could push memory over threshold.

henry: Good catch. I can reproduce locally by running synthetic longseq with sdk:3.2 + runtime:4.0 + q4b-v2. Memory climbs >85% after warmup.

fiona: Options: 1) revert runtime allocator change (runtime:4.0 rollback in ap-southeast), 2) increase host memory (longer term), 3) disable eager-cache in SDK temporarily for ap-southeast. Which is fastest?

kai: Rollback runtime is quickest for region-specific mitigation. SDK change affects many regions but can be toggled via feature flag per region.

marta: If we toggle SDK flag, we avoid touching runtime and model kernels. But we must coordinate with CDNs and edge releases.

henry: Rollback risk: kernel mismatch for model variants expecting 4.0 kernels. But we have fallback routing; acceptable for night window.

fiona: Proposal: perform a regional runtime rollback to 3.9 at 01:10 UTC (canary 10% for 5m), then monitor mem/latency for 30m. Also create an SDK feature-flag patch to gate eager-cache with per-region override.

deploybot: SCHEDULED rollback job: rollback-runtime-4.0 -> 3.9 in ap-southeast-1 at 2026-03-21T01:10:00Z (initiated by fiona). job id: rb-606543-01

infra-bot: NOTE: auto-unpin protections engaged. Do not unpin pinned runtime until rollback stabilizes.

fiona: I'll own the rollback window and telemetry. Kai, Henry please run stress harness after phase1. Marta please open SDK flag PR and mark it deployable tomorrow morning.

kai: phase1 started (canary 10%) — deploybot logging: /deploys/606543/rb-01/phase1

deploybot: INFO rollback phase1 complete (canary) at 2026-03-21T01:15:12Z

henry: canary traces look good. Mem drop ~12%, p95 back to baseline. Running 30m longseq stress now.

deploybot: INFO rollback complete (100%) at 2026-03-21T01:46:27Z

kai: longseq stress 30m done — mem stable at ~58-62%, latency p95 within normal. No OOMs.

fiona: Great. Now we'll keep runtime pinned temporarily until we get SDK flag out and validated. Let's add an entry to release notes and the runbook.

marta: PR opened: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/901 — feature: region-eager-cache-override. Includes migration notes and rollout plan. ETA: tests + canary tomorrow.

henry: Runbook note: "If runtime allocator change causes host memory increase, prefer regional runtime rollback + SDK region-flag patch before global revert. Ensure fallback routing is healthy." I'll add it.

fiona: Release note (internal): "2026-03-21: Regional rollback of runtime:4.0 -> 3.9 in ap-southeast-1 to mitigate memory pressure with q4b-v2 under sdk:3.2 eager-cache. Follow-up: SDK region flag to gate eager-cache, and fix allocator in runtime 4.0 branch."

deploybot: INFO scheduled unpin for hosts (manual approval required) at 2026-03-21T05:00:00Z

kai: Let's leave pin in place until we confirm SDK patch rollouts across regions. I'll monitor 24h.

marta: I'll coordinate canary tomorrow and post rollout schedule in this thread.

fiona: Thanks all. Small ask: add a short note for partners that q4b-v2 expects runtime>=4.0 kernels; temporary routing to q4b-v1 may increase latency. I'll draft a one-liner for partner-comm.

henry: adding postmortem stub and linking diagnostics: /incidents/606543-mdm.

fiona: closing loop for now. We'll convert this thread into an internal release note in the morning.
